params.delegate: the contract to delegate checkUpkeep calls to
params.firstJob: an optional encoding of the first cron job
params.maxJobs: the max number of cron jobs this contract will support
params.owner: the initial owner of the contract

params.encodedCronSpec: abi encoding of a cron spec
params.handler: the function signature on the target contract to call
params.target: the destination contract of a cron job

params.id: the id of the cron job to delete

returns._0: list of active cron job IDs

returns.target: - the address a cron job forwards the eth tx to handler - the encoded function sig to execute when forwarding a tx cronString - the string representing the cron job nextTick - the timestamp of the next time the cron job will run
